content:
Avery Chen: Quick follow-up from yesterday's arch session: we need a minimal intake acceptance payload that all downstream services can rely on. Can we agree on fields and failure modes?

Diego Ramos: Agreed. Minimality is key. Suggested fields: artifact_id, accepted (bool), reason (optional), smoke_checks: {ok, p95_ms}, bench_score (opt), compat_flags (list). Keep names snake_case so infra is consistent.

Priya Shah: +1. Also add tokenizer_hash and kv_shape_signature as compatibility touchpoints. Those are cheap to compute and catch many silent failures.

Nadia Ortiz: Ops perspective: we need canary metadata too: initial_canary_pct, canary_window_secs, auto_rollback_threshold. If intake returns these, deployer can wire a default canary policy.

Avery Chen: Draft intake payload (example) - please critique:

```
{
  "artifact_id": "mdl_2026_07_15_001",
  "accepted": true,
  "smoke_pass": true,
  "smoke_p95_ms": "120",
  "bench_score": "0.93",
  "tokenizer_hash": "sha256:abcd...",
  "kv_shape_signature": "[1,64,1024]",
  "compat_flags": ["quant_ok","attn_patch"],
  "initial_canary_pct": "1",
  "canary_window_secs": "3600",
  "auto_rollback_threshold": "error_rate>0.05"
}
```

Diego Ramos: Looks good. A couple of nits: bench_score should be nullable string or omitted when not run. auto_rollback_threshold as a simple expression string is fine for now. Add a field "notes_url" where bench artifacts live.

Priya Shah: For smoke_p95_ms, include the input_profile tag so we know which golden set produced it, e.g., smoke_profile: "chat_short_seq". Otherwise p95 numbers are ambiguous across families.

Nadia Ortiz: Add a field "quarantine": "none|auto|manual" so ops can quickly filter problematic artifacts. Also suggest "escalation_level" for high-cost or regulated models.

ops-bot: automation check - adding required telemetry hooks: intake.smoke_pass, intake.smoke_p95_ms, intake.tokenizer_mismatch, intake.kv_signature_diff. Registry will pick these up if present in payload.

Avery Chen: Good call. Proposed minimal required fields for the schema: artifact_id, accepted, smoke_pass, smoke_profile, tokenizer_hash, kv_shape_signature, quarantine. Optional: bench_score, compat_flags, initial_canary_pct, notes_url.

Diego Ramos: On sequencing: smoke must be blocking on intake. Bench should be async and write back bench_score/note_url to registry. Deployer should only read acceptance payload for immediate decisions.

Priya Shah: For compatibility checks, add a short probe that runs a KV warmup of a few tokens to detect shape or dtype mismatches. Capture that result in kv_warmup_ok boolean.

Nadia Ortiz: Canary playbook sketch: start at initial_canary_pct, monitor error_rate and latency p95 for the canary window, if error_rate > rollback threshold OR p95 increases > X% then throttle down to 0 and tag model as quarantine:auto with note. We should keep the playbook as a one-pager in runbooks/ on-call.

Avery Chen: Operational edgecases: what if artifact accepted=true but kv_warmup_ok=false? Suggest accepted=true but compat_flags includes "kv_warn" and quarantine:auto false so teams get alerted but rollout can proceed if they accept the risk.

Diego Ramos: Also add a "verified_by" field when a human overrides. That helps audits.

Priya Shah: For semantic regressions, bench_score should reference the eval set id used and include an embedding-similarity score to catch drift not visible in token diffs.

Nadia Ortiz: Timeline: get intake schema locked this sprint, smoke runner prototype next sprint, async bench integration in 3-4. Ops will prep runbook in parallel.

Avery Chen: Action list: Priya to propose smoke_profile taxonomy; Diego to update intake API with the example JSON and nullable rules; Nadia to draft canary playbook bullets; I'll collect and update RFC followup.

Diego Ramos: I'll post a sample intake API spec later today (stable JSON schema + examples). Will mark fields as required/optional.

Priya Shah: I'll assemble a small golden set taxonomy doc with suggested sizes per workload. Keep sizes minimal for smoke but explicit for deep bench.

Nadia Ortiz: Ops will add alerts for intake.smoke_pass==false and canary rollback triggers. We'll test with the prototype.

Avery Chen: Thanks everyone. Let's keep this thread for quick synces; I'll pull into RFC followup once Diego posts the schema.
